ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a distribution chart of the status of various types of sea use in China in recent years. Read the figure and answer the following questions. <image1> Among the various types of sea use, which type accounts for the largest proportion?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a pie distribution chart of the status of various types of sea use in China in recent years. The largest sector in the pie chart is labeled “fishery 89.20%”; the smaller sectors on the right are successively labeled “transportation 4.25%”, “industry and mining 2.00%”, “land reclamation by enclosing the sea 1.91%”, etc., and their proportions are all obviously smaller than fishery. Then reason: Comparing the percentages accounted for by the various types of sea use, 89.20% is the largest, so the type accounting for the largest proportion is fishery.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图为我国各类用海状况的饼状分布图，多个扇区旁标有类型和百分比。读取各类用海比例，发现“渔业”标注为89.20%，明显高于交通运输4.25%、工矿2.00%等其他类型。因此所占比例最大的类型是渔业。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是我国近年来各类用海状况的饼状分布图。饼图中最大的扇区标注为“渔业 89.20%”；右侧较小扇区依次标有“交通运输 4.25%”“工矿 2.00%”“围海造地 1.91%”等，比例都明显小于渔业。再推理：比较各类用海所占百分比，89.20%最大，因此所占比例最大的类型是渔业。
